title: Centuria (manga) — Meaning, Genes, And Nothing Else #Shorts
description:
What looks like free choice in Centuria (manga) is older than choice itself. Centuria (Japanese: ケントゥリア, Hepburn: Kenturia) is a Japanese web manga series written and illustrated by Tohru Kuramori. It has been serialized in Shueisha's Shōnen Jump+ app and website since April 2024, with its chapters collected in ten tankōbon volumes as of October 2026.

Freud is not dead; he is simply no longer allowed to be the whole answer. In June 2025, Viz Media announced that they had licensed the series for English publication beginning in Q2 2026. Vanessa Piña of Screen Rant highlighted the significant influence of Berserk on Centuria, particularly praising its art and monster designs.
